verdict.rationale: Ledgy's marketing claims 70+ HRIS integrations to keep large volumes of data accurate, plus one-click syncing of custom fields, so HRIS-driven stakeholder sync is claimed. The evidence is only marketing copy, with no docs on how the sync works or which events it covers. Missing for 10: named support for Gusto/Rippling or other specific HRIS/payroll systems, evidence that new hires and terminations flow into equity records automatically, setup or sync-frequency documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
